adapter_config._comment: Adapter-defined keys live here. The driver reads only the top-level keys (adapter, system_name, a5_delay_hours); everything under adapter_config belongs to the adapter named above and is documented in that adapter's module. Copy adapters/stub.py to adapters/<your_system>.py, implement the five operations, and replace this block with your adapter's keys.

system_name: Example system (replace with the system under test)
